scientific_limitations.critical_premise: Uses the published Timofte--Riener half-degree principle for symmetric quartic inequalities.
scientific_limitations.domain: Real ell_4^n on finite uniform atoms; one mean-reflection involution I-2E.
scientific_limitations.evidence_integrity: The dimension-uniform argument is analytical; exact finite algebra and an n=8 root certificate are reproducible with CHECK.py. Numerical experiments alone are not used for infinite statements.
scientific_limitations.excluded: Complex inputs, arbitrary atomic weights, and the full unconditional constant of the Haar basis.
scientific_limitations.literature_risks: The 2016 Lewicki--Skrzypek and 1990 Franchetti hyperplane-projection papers could not be examined in full; unindexed overlap remains possible.

title: Exact finite-atom \(L^4\) mean-reflection constants and the irrational attainment gap
